CustomField.description: The maximum length of the reply, in tokens. Sent as the request's own maximum-token setting where the call takes one (the prompt template path; the Models API chat request takes none). The reply is also cut at about 4 characters a token as a backstop. Blank means the length the calling code passes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tokens, about 4 characters each. Blank means the calling code's length.
CustomField.label: Maximum Tokens
